Bright and clean 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located at 5638 Birney Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6S 0H8 UBC Wesbrook Village

Monthly rent: $3,600 for 12 months lease
$3900 for 8 months lease
Size: 879 sq. ft.
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Availability: Immediately
Basic furniture included
No smoking
No pets

This well-maintained home features a practical two-bedroom, two-bathroom layout. The two separate bathrooms provide extra privacy and convenience for a family or two roommates.

The living room has large windows with plenty of natural light and pleasant views of the surrounding greenery. The open-concept kitchen offers a modern and functional living space.

The unit also includes:

In-suite washer and dryer
Private balcony
Bed, desk, dining table and sofa
Bright living and dining area
Modern kitchen
Quiet UBC neighbourhood

The successful tenant must obtain tenant insurance before moving in. Tenant pay own utilities and internet.
